title: aggregate router
description: Collects messages; when the group is complete (the last part of a split, or completionSize messages), passes on the last message with the aggregate of their bodies. In DIL it is an action.

aggregateType.title: Aggregate type
aggregateType.description: XML: the parts' root elements in <Aggregated>; JSON: an array of the parts

completionSize.title: Completion size
completionSize.description: Number of messages that complete a group; 0: only the last part of a split does
